name: Wake Me Up If You Need Me
source:
Being a night owl, you naturally have trouble sleeping. Sleep is important for the average person, but you're a university student who loves to do their homework from 12AM onwards. Luckily, you have a friend that's literally a call away!

Why're you taking calculus? I don't know, calculus is pretty hard. But it's okay, just ask him to help you. He's been your friend for a while after all!! He sounds rude, but don't worry that's just cause he's sleepy<3

Just be sure to try and communicate properly with each other, okay? I would hate for you guys to argue.

[From [url=https://rice373.itch.io/wake-me-up-if-you-need-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为一个夜猫子，你自然会遇到睡眠问题。睡眠对于普通人来说很重要，但你是一名喜欢从凌晨12点开始做作业的大学生。幸运的是，你有一个朋友，只需一个电话即可到达！

你为什么要学微积分？我不知道，微积分很难。不过没关系，请他帮你就可以了。毕竟他已经是你的朋友有一段时间了！！他听起来很粗鲁，但别担心那只是因为他困了<3请务必尝试彼此正确沟通，好吗？我讨厌你们争论。

[来自[url=https://rice373.itch.io/wake-me-up-if-you-need-me]itch.io[/url]]
